summary: Custer County Sawtooth peak; a lookout listing gives a 1939 staffed lookout point, but its forest conflicts with Wikipedia and the brief coordinates sit about 24 km off.

visit.trail_note: Wikipedia gives the easiest route to the summit as class 3 scrambling.

events.note: Listed as a staffed lookout point; facilities not known

corrections.why: Wikipedia gives the peak at 44.2132397; -115.0809242, about 24 km from the brief point. The 1939 lookout may not sit on the summit, so a human should check before this is applied.

evidence.supports: 1939 staffed lookout point, facilities not known
evidence.quote: 1939: This was a staffed lookout point. Facilities not known.

evidence.supports: Custer County heading above the McGowan Peak entry
evidence.quote: CUSTER COUNTY McGOWAN PEAK Challis National Forest

evidence.supports: Peak is 9,860 feet above sea level
evidence.quote: that is 9,860 feet (3,010 m) above sea level

evidence.quote: McGowan Peak (variant name McGown Peak) is a peak in the Sawtooth Range of Idaho that is 9,860 feet (3,010 m) above sea level.

evidence.supports: Peak in Sawtooth Wilderness of Sawtooth NRA, Custer County
evidence.quote: The peak is located in the Sawtooth Wilderness of Sawtooth National Recreation Area in Custer County

evidence.supports: Rises above southwest end of Stanley Lake
evidence.quote: McGowan Peak rises above the southwest end of Stanley Lake

notes_for_editor: Agency conflict, not resolved: the lookout listing says Challis NF, while Wikipedia places the peak in the Sawtooth Wilderness of the Sawtooth NRA and cites a Sawtooth National Forest map. facts.agency follows the listing and should be checked. The brief coordinates are about 24 km from Wikipedia's summit coordinates; the correction is proposed, not applied. No page read describes a structure or its fate. firelookout.org's Idaho list has no McGowan entry. Search snippets (a 1939 Stanley Lake photo caption without a lookout, and a Twin Peaks lookout near Challis) were not verified and are not used.
